about: Antenna feed points of the AWR2944 EVM (PROC113D) from TI's layout database SPRR441 (PROC113D_ASCII.PcbDoc, top layer, nets RX1-RX4 and TX1-TX4 = device RX0-RX3 and TX0-TX3), relative to RX0 and the main antenna row; x along the azimuth array, z up. Identical antenna elements, so the feed-point differences are the phase-centre differences.
